```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

nba <- read_csv("../data/regular_season_totals_2010_2024.csv")
```

```{r}
nba <- nba |>
  mutate(
    GAME_DATE = as.Date(GAME_DATE, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
  )
```

```{r}
class(nba$GAME_DATE)
sum(is.na(nba$GAME_DATE))
```
```{r}
nba <- nba |>
  mutate(
    Weekday = wday(GAME_DATE, label = TRUE, week_start = 1)
  )
count(nba, Weekday)
```
```{r}
nba_five <- nba |>
  filter(TEAM_NAME %in% c(
    "Boston Celtics",
    "Golden State Warriors",
    "Los Angeles Lakers",
    "Miami Heat",
    "Minnesota Timberwolves"
  ))

count(nba_five, TEAM_NAME)
```
```{r}
nba_five |>
  group_by(TEAM_NAME, Weekday) |>
  summarize(
    Games = n()
  )
```
# Do NBA teams perform differently on different days of the week?

```{r}
weekday_performance <- nba_five |>
  group_by(TEAM_NAME, Weekday) |>
  summarize(
    Average_PM = mean(PLUS_MINUS, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_PM = sd(PLUS_MINUS, na.rm = TRUE),
    Games = n()
  )

weekday_performance
```
# Figure 1 — Average Performance
```{r}
ggplot(
  weekday_performance,
  aes(x = Weekday, y = Average_PM)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  facet_wrap(~ TEAM_NAME) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Average NBA Point Differential by Weekday",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Average Point Differential"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
# Figure 2 — Performance Distribution
```{r}
ggplot(
  nba_five,
  aes(x = Weekday, y = PLUS_MINUS)
) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "yellow", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ TEAM_NAME) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of NBA Point Differentials by Weekday",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Point Differential"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
